MON MAR 1 · MIAMI, FLORIDA · ARRIVING
Miami, Florida ✎ Rename
Lock this day
Today is one plan

Flight in at 9:00 am, then the ship at 3:30 pm: the sightseeing in between, your bags and the countdown are on one page.

See today's plan

cards.text:
LEAVE
10:15 am
S
Out of Miami International Airport
Flight arrives 9:00 am. We allow 1 h 15 min to get off the plane and through baggage claim (and passport control after a flight from abroad). Your bags go with you to the ship: porters take them at the cruise terminal.
You fly in the day the ship sails, so today goes straight from the airport to the ship: there isn't enough time for sightseeing with a safe margin. A late or missed flight is the most common way travelers miss a ship, and the ship won't wait. Keep your airline's and cruise line's phone numbers handy, and if a delay is announced, call the cruise line at once.

Taxi or car · 1 h 1 min · 9.6 mi
Includes 15 min spare before the ship.
No timetable or live traffic confirms this ride's time: it is an estimate with 15 min extra for the connection. Leave by the time shown, never later.

ARRIVE
11:16 am
E
Boarding at Port of Miami Cruise Terminals
3 h 14 min to spare.
Official all aboard 3:30 pm: be at the terminal by 2:30 pm at the latest. Your cruise line gives you a boarding time: add it and the plan gets you there for it.
Porters take your big bags at the curb (luggage tags on; they reach your cabin by evening). Keep your passport, boarding pass, medicines and valuables in your carry-on for check-in and security.
Big ports have more than one cruise terminal: check yours on your boarding pass and tell the driver.
Book the taxi or transfer the day before, or ask your hotel to call one. Being aboard on time is your responsibility: check your boarding time with your cruise line.
